writesNothingButItsText rebuilds from TextContent, so a pasted soft break (hardbreak isInline) or a trailing line feed in the text is refused as markup with a quote that looks plain: the same false-refusal class as round 2's M1.
The upload step names only --issue <KEY>; an ask on a project document needs --project <KEY>. 'the one case a document edit cannot reach' overstates: a nested decision with no text is another.
